note: Closed instrument definition. fixture.steps run through the REAL des CLI in a fresh git repository. The one labelled legacy seed writes historical state; host_setup fixtures deterministically author declared oracle/support files and supply explicit structured host facts, never measured outcomes or model responses. A step whose expect does not hold makes fixture-status setup-failed and the case is never passed to a host. Inputs resolve under fixtures/ ({PYTHON} is substituted by the des interpreter). expected.first_mutating is matched against the normalized FIRST MUTATING des invocation (--repo-root removed); read-only des state/help inspection before it is recorded but never counts as the first operation.
